info.prompt: Cyberpunk alchemist's lab meets high-stakes digital casino: gilded iron UI panels shaped like cathedral arches house a glowing Farkle grid, every tile a faceted gemstone die suspended in plasma blue energy fields, Stone Blockers crackling with granite fissures, Wild tiles emitting rainbow corona bursts, the background a depth-blurred neural network of crimson synaptic connections fading into infinite darkness.
